title: Local privilege-based compromise of a FactoryTalk View SE HMI server

attacker_profile.description: An attacker who obtains a low-privileged local Windows session on the HMI server.

entry_point.description: Support device used for HMI maintenance.

target.description: HMI server running FactoryTalk View SE 13.0.

attack_path.name: Initial Access
attack_path.description: The attacker compromises a support path.
required_conditions: The support account or device is compromised.

attack_path.name: Low-Privileged Local Access
attack_path.description: The attacker obtains a low-privileged local Windows session on the HMI server.
required_conditions: A low-privileged local user context is available.

attack_path.name: Modify HMI Project Files
attack_path.description: The attacker attempts to edit or replace HMI project files.

attack_path.name: Execution with Elevated Permissions
attack_path.description: Modified files are executed by an elevated account or service.
required_conditions: The modified files are subsequently executed.

attack_path.name: Compromise HMI Functions
attack_path.description: HMI compromise may affect visualization or operator commands.
required_conditions: The HMI remains connected to the controller.

attack_path.name: Impact
attack_path.description: The attack may impair HMI integrity or availability.
required_conditions: The compromised HMI function is operationally relevant.

global_preconditions: The attacker has a low-privileged local user context.
assumptions: This case intentionally tests a local, not remote, vulnerability.
